name: deterioration_token_clock
description: The deterioration row of all six big layers in the generated_tokens mode, deterioration.json with the switch clock_mode at generated_tokens and nothing else changed. The tokens the agent's model generates between two calls, each counted as seconds_per_token seconds of the asset file, add up from call to call into one cycle per full think_seconds_per_cycle, so a call is charged the same thinking time whatever the load of the machine that serves the model. A second condition beside deterioration.json, whose clock is the clock of record, for the six rows of the agents in the environment.
